mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in consumer demand (GDPC1) signals stronger economic activity, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 shows a sustained upward trend over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 1.5% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and declining unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a dual easing of monetary policy and labor market strength, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS <1.5% and UNRATE <4.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, low CPIAUCSL inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) combined with ultra-low FEDFUNDS rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion when both CPIAUCSL <2 and FEDFUNDS <1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment (PAYEMS > 150,000) signals labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite PAYEMS crossing above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) suggests a supply-demand imbalance favoring demand, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) alongside ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicates improving labor market conditions and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive in post-shock recovery when both UNRATE <4 and FEDFUNDS <1.5%.
